Rules / Tool

SK9021 The binlog does not name a file that exists

A .cs file under the repository is in no recorded compilation. Rebuild.

CategoryTool
Default severitywarning
ScopeCompilation
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileno — it reads the whole compilation
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.6

Why

A new file that the binlog does not name is invisible to every compilation and is therefore silently unanalysed, which is the worst failure this tool can have. It is a warning and not an info for exactly that reason.

When it does not fire

A file genuinely excluded from compilation — a scratch file, a .cs under a directory with EnableDefaultCompileItems=false — is reported too. skala.jsonc's exclude is the answer, and the message names the file.

Configuration

  • skala.jsonc: exclude
